messages:
maiya: quick sync 1 writing a compact 'provisioning quickstart' for Dedicated capacity. goal: 1-screen checklist + three tiny snippets: CLI dry-run, terraform migration hint, CI grep. keep it minimal.

ken: +1. call out tenant-label mismatch as the top failure. add `rwdctl tenant validate-labels --tenant-id T-1` as step 1.

maiya: added. CLI preview snippet: `rwdctl reserved create --tenant T-1 --gpu a100 --region us-west-2 --dry-run` and note: use `--commit` to apply.

ioana: include a terse terraform migration hint for legacy scale_policy -> balanced/throughput. one small block.

maiya: terraform hint:
```hcl
resource "rwd_dedicated_pool" "p" {
  tenant_id = var.tenant_id
  autoscale { policy = "balanced" }
}
```

ken: add CI pre-apply grep so teams fail fast: `grep -R "scale_policy:\s*legacy" || true` with recommended action to run migration script.

maiya: adding that and a one-line troubleshooting checklist: labels, quotas (`aws service-quotas`), KMS key policy, provisioner logs (`rwdctl logs provisioner --tenant T-1`).

ioana: IMPORTANT: isolation decorators can move traffic to reserved pools and change SLA. add a bold callout and tell customers to contact CSM before enabling.

maiya: short note added: "Isolation annotations may alter routing and SLA; verify with your CSM before enabling in prod."

docs-bot: PR opened by maiya: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/docs/+/6012 :eyes:

ken: i'll review. keep it <1 page and ship small.

maiya: will merge after linter and one review. ping here when live. :shipit:
